summary: Edesa Biotech filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of common shares, pre-funded warrants, and common share warrants. The offering price per unit is set at $5.71 (August 18, 2026 close) with warrant exercise prices and terms to be finalized. The company is the issuer raising capital, not engaging in a special-situation transaction. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration. Watch for final pricing and exercise price details in the subsequent prospectus supplement, but no special-situation event is present.
